test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Upon hearing the great achievements of the historic character, he was in __a state of ____awed admiration and respect.__
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Wonderment**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Wonderment is a noun word, describing a state of something. 
 
• **Wonderment **means **a state of amazement.**
 
• The correct sentence would be, **Upon hearing the great achievements of the historic character, he was in wonderment.**
